newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$800 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$800 mln of notes.

text.p: The Australian Treasury will offer a total of A$800 million of Treasury notes for tender on Tuesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
The tender comprises A$200 million of five-week notes, A$200 million of 13-week notes and A$400 million of 26-week notes.
The RBA said it would take up an additional A$200 million of the five-week notes, A$200 million of 13-week notes and A$300 million of 26-week notes for its own portfolio.
The Treasury offered a total of A$1.3 billion of notes on December 18, comprising A$500 million of five-week notes, A$300 million of 13-week notes and A$500 million of 26-week notes.
